tool.name: Biomni: Analyze Bacterial Growth Curve
tool.description: Analyzes bacterial growth curve data to determine growth parameters.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.immunology import analyze_bacterial_growth_curve
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = analyze_bacterial_growth_curve(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --time_points '$time_points' --od_values '$od_values' --strain_name '$strain_name' #if $output_dir --output_dir '$output_dir' #end if

param.name: time_points
param.label: Time Points
param.help: Time points of measurements in hours

param.name: od_values
param.label: Od Values
param.help: Optical density measurements corresponding to each time point

param.name: strain_name
param.label: Strain Name
param.help: Name of the bacterial strain being analyzed

param.name: output_dir
param.label: Output Dir
param.help: Directory where output files will be saved (default: current directory)

tool.help:
**Biomni: Analyze Bacterial Growth Curve**
Analyzes bacterial growth curve data to determine growth parameters.
Parameters ---------- time_points : list or numpy.ndarray Time points of measurements in hours od_values : list or numpy.ndarray Optical density measurements corresponding to each time point strain_name : str Name of the bacterial strain being analyzed output_dir : str, optional Directory where output files will be saved (default: current directory)
Returns ------- str A research log summarizing the analysis steps and results
**Domain**: immunology **Function**: analyze_bacterial_growth_curve
